---
name: Feature Request / 功能请求
about: Propose a new feature or improvement / 提出新功能或改进建议
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Feature Description / 功能描述

Clearly and concisely describe the feature you would like to add.
清晰简明地描述您希望添加的功能。

## Problem Background / 问题背景

Describe the problem this feature solves or the use case.
描述这个功能要解决的问题或使用场景。

## Expected Solution / 期望解决方案

Describe how you would like this feature to be implemented.
描述您希望如何实现这个功能。

## Alternative Solutions / 替代方案

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered.
描述您考虑过的任何替代解决方案或功能。

## Additional Information / 附加信息

Add any other information or screenshots about the feature request.
添加任何其他信息或关于功能请求的截图。

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and feature requests to confirm this is not a duplicate / 我已搜索现有的 issues 和 feature requests，确认没有重复建议
- [ ] I have clearly described the feature requirements and use case / 我已清晰描述功能的需求和使用场景
- [ ] I have considered alternative solutions / 我已考虑替代方案
